artifact_observations.reasoning: The metal surfaces lack realistic specular highlights and reflections. They appear matte and slightly 'muddy' rather than shiny steel, suggesting a texture generation issue.

The row of identical metal shapes at the bottom merges into the wooden background slightly. Their geometry is nonsensical—they look like melted loops or brackets that don't correspond to any standard tool, indicating a structural hallucination.
The perspective on the wooden handles is slightly inconsistent; the ferrules (metal part connecting handle to shaft) seem to float or attach loosely without clear mechanical integration.
